# MarketWatch
> Financial news, market data, investing analysis, and personal finance coverage for individual investors.

MarketWatch covers U.S. and global markets with real-time quotes, breaking news, commentary, portfolio tools, and consumer-focused money reporting. Its site spans market dashboards, asset-class coverage, retirement and personal finance guidance, and premium analysis.

## Core Pages
- [Home](https://www.marketwatch.com/): Main MarketWatch homepage with top financial news, market data, and featured analysis.
- [Latest News](https://www.marketwatch.com/latest-news): Continuously updated stream of breaking market, business, and economic news.
- [Watchlist](https://www.marketwatch.com/watchlist): Track selected stocks, funds, and other securities in a personalized list.
- [My Portfolio](https://www.marketwatch.com/my): Portfolio area for monitoring holdings, performance, and saved market information.
- [Games](https://www.marketwatch.com/games): Investing and stock market simulation tools for learning and competition.
- [Press Room](https://www.marketwatch.com/press-room): Corporate and editorial announcements related to MarketWatch and its products.

## Markets
- [Markets](https://www.marketwatch.com/markets): Central hub for market coverage, indexes, movers, and trading-day developments.
- [U.S. Markets](https://www.marketwatch.com/markets/us): News and data focused on U.S. stocks, indexes, and trading activity.
- [Europe & Middle East Markets](https://www.marketwatch.com/markets/europe-middle-east): Regional market coverage, quotes, and news from Europe and the Middle East.
- [Asia Markets](https://www.marketwatch.com/markets/asia): Coverage of Asian stock markets, indexes, and regional business developments.
- [Futures](https://www.marketwatch.com/investing/futures): Quotes and news for futures contracts across major markets.
- [Currencies](https://www.marketwatch.com/investing/currencies): Exchange-rate quotes, currency market news, and related analysis.
- [Rates & Bonds](https://www.marketwatch.com/investing/bonds): Bond market data, Treasury yields, and fixed-income coverage.
- [Economic Calendar](https://www.marketwatch.com/economy-politics/calendar): Schedule of economic releases and events relevant to investors.

## Investing
- [Investing](https://www.marketwatch.com/investing): Broad investing coverage spanning stocks, funds, ETFs, and strategies.
- [Stocks](https://www.marketwatch.com/investing/stocks): Stock quotes, company pages, and equity market reporting.
- [Mutual Funds](https://www.marketwatch.com/investing/funds): Mutual fund data, performance information, and related fund news.
- [ETFs](https://www.marketwatch.com/investing/etf): Exchange-traded fund quotes, screening, and ETF-focused reporting.
- [Commodities](https://www.marketwatch.com/investing/commodities): Commodity prices, futures-linked coverage, and market commentary.
- [Cryptocurrency](https://www.marketwatch.com/investing/cryptocurrency): Crypto prices, digital asset news, and market analysis.
- [IPO Market](https://www.marketwatch.com/tools/ipo-calendar): IPO calendar and information on upcoming and recent public offerings.

## Tools & Data
- [Market Data Center](https://www.marketwatch.com/tools/marketsummary): Snapshot of major indexes, sectors, rates, commodities, and currencies.
- [Stock Screener](https://www.marketwatch.com/tools/stockresearch/screener): Filter stocks by fundamentals, performance, and market characteristics.
- [Fund Screener](https://www.marketwatch.com/tools/mutual-fundresearch/mutual-fund-screener): Screen mutual funds using performance, fees, and category criteria.
- [ETF Screener](https://www.marketwatch.com/tools/etfresearch/etf-screener): Search and compare ETFs by asset class, issuer, and returns.
- [Economic Calendar](https://www.marketwatch.com/economy-politics/calendar): Track scheduled economic reports, Fed events, and other market-moving releases.
- [Retirement Planner](https://www.marketwatch.com/retirement-planning-calculator): Calculator for estimating retirement savings and income needs.
- [Mortgage Calculator](https://www.marketwatch.com/mortgage-calculator): Estimate monthly mortgage payments and borrowing costs.
- [CD Rates](https://www.marketwatch.com/guides/cd-rates/): Rate-focused guide tracking certificate of deposit offerings and comparisons.

## Personal Finance
- [Personal Finance](https://www.marketwatch.com/personal-finance): Coverage of saving, spending, taxes, debt, and household financial decisions.
- [Retirement](https://www.marketwatch.com/retirement): News and advice on retirement planning, Social Security, and income strategies.
- [Taxes](https://www.marketwatch.com/personal-finance/taxes): Reporting and guidance on tax rules, filing, and policy changes.
- [Banking](https://www.marketwatch.com/guides/banking/): Guides to bank accounts, savings products, and banking comparisons.
- [Credit Cards](https://www.marketwatch.com/guides/credit-cards/): Reviews and guides for credit cards, rewards, and borrowing features.
- [Mortgages](https://www.marketwatch.com/guides/mortgages/): Mortgage guides, lender comparisons, and home financing explainers.
- [Insurance](https://www.marketwatch.com/guides/insurance/): Consumer guides covering insurance products, costs, and comparisons.
- [Student Loans](https://www.marketwatch.com/guides/student-loans/): Reporting and guides on borrowing, repayment, and refinancing options.

## Economy & Politics
- [Economy & Politics](https://www.marketwatch.com/economy-politics): News and analysis on macroeconomics, government policy, and regulation.
- [Federal Reserve](https://www.marketwatch.com/topics/federal-reserve): Coverage of Fed decisions, speeches, and monetary policy implications.
- [Inflation](https://www.marketwatch.com/topics/inflation): Articles and analysis focused on inflation data and price trends.
- [Jobs Report](https://www.marketwatch.com/topics/jobs-report): Coverage of employment data releases and labor market implications.
- [U.S. Economy](https://www.marketwatch.com/topics/u-s-economy): Reporting on growth, recession risks, and economic indicators.
- [Washington Watch](https://www.marketwatch.com/column/washington-watch): Column covering policy, politics, and their effects on markets and consumers.

## Industries & Companies
- [Technology](https://www.marketwatch.com/technology): News and analysis on tech companies, products, and sector trends.
- [Energy](https://www.marketwatch.com/industries/energy): Coverage of oil, gas, utilities, and energy market developments.
- [Real Estate](https://www.marketwatch.com/real-estate): News on housing, commercial property, and real-estate investing trends.
- [Autos](https://www.marketwatch.com/industries/autos): Reporting on automakers, EVs, and transportation industry developments.
- [Health Care](https://www.marketwatch.com/industries/health-care): Coverage of pharmaceutical, biotech, and health-care business news.
- [Financials](https://www.marketwatch.com/industries/financials): News and analysis on banks, insurers, and financial services firms.

## Commentary & Columns
- [Opinion](https://www.marketwatch.com/opinion): Commentary, columns, and perspective on markets, policy, and personal finance.
- [Barron's Picks](https://www.marketwatch.com/barrons-picks): Selected Barron's content surfaced for MarketWatch readers.
- [The Moneyist](https://www.marketwatch.com/personal-finance/the-moneyist): Advice column addressing family, money, inheritance, and relationship disputes.
- [Retirement Weekly](https://www.marketwatch.com/retirement/retirement-weekly): Retirement-focused column with planning ideas and portfolio perspectives.
- [Best New Ideas in Money](https://www.marketwatch.com/personal-finance/best-new-ideas-in-money): Feature series on emerging consumer finance and policy topics.
- [Capitol Report](https://www.marketwatch.com/column/capitol-report): Column on Washington policy, legislation, and market implications.

## Guides & Reviews
- [MarketWatch Guides](https://www.marketwatch.com/guides/): Product reviews, comparisons, and consumer financial explainers.
- [Investing Guides](https://www.marketwatch.com/guides/investing/): Educational and comparison content for brokerage and investing decisions.
- [Banking Guides](https://www.marketwatch.com/guides/banking/): Guides to savings accounts, CDs, checking, and banking products.
- [Credit Card Guides](https://www.marketwatch.com/guides/credit-cards/): Reviews and rankings of cards by rewards, fees, and use case.
- [Home Guides](https://www.marketwatch.com/guides/home-warranty/): Consumer review content for home-related service products and warranties.
- [Auto Guides](https://www.marketwatch.com/guides/car-warranty/): Reviews and comparisons for auto warranties and related services.
